decision_basis: Saved authoritative-source HTTP 200, exact size, SHA-256, container-signature, title, description, publisher, and file-host evidence were applied without a repeat source fetch. The 18 records are NMDOT-administered state and federal transportation grant-application, payment, closeout, and prioritization material for transit providers and local governments.

placement_review.reason: Development Process documents Albuquerque and Bernalillo County land-development review, not state or federal transportation grant administration. Existing Transportation and Transit pages describe plans, projects, services, and system history, rather than a public grant-administration resource. No existing topical page genuinely fits this family or any individual record without forcing a misleading placement.
placement_review.information_architecture_need: A future, separately authorized decision may establish an appropriate state/federal transportation grant-administration or transit-funding resource page and decide whether this operational family has sufficient public-facing value for a curated presentation.

archive_publication_gates: No public content placement, implementation, or validation is authorized by this decision.

Each static original must be archived to R2 in its recorded original format, then its public download must pass exact size, SHA-256, and authoritative-source provenance verification before any site addition.
The OOXML, OLE2, and PDF container identifications are preservation instructions, not conversion instructions.
